title: De-fragmenting C++: Making Exceptions and RTTI More Affordable and Usable - Herb Sutter  CppCon 2019
summary: Herb Sutter's CppCon 2019 talk on the split in the C++ community over exceptions and RTTI. He proposes making exceptions cheaper and more usable, including a zero-overhead, Result-like design.
why: Pointed to whenever C++ exception overhead, bans on exceptions or error-handling alternatives come up.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I can really recommend this talk
